roles.title: Product Manager, Collaboration Tools
roles.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States

bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for one of our key products (e.g. FigJam), and help drive our vision of Collab Tools as the defacto surfaces for upstream planning and discovery.
Partner deeply with Design and Engineering to ship both foundational improvements and 0-to-1 bets, holding a high bar for craft and consumer-grade quality.

Define and run agent evals defined by our vision and grounded in real user behavior to measure and improve quality, latency, and cost.
